releaseNotes: Preview is now an ordinary playlist of clipped media items on the same ExoPlayer the library uses, so editing playback works and reports its own errors. The playhead is drawn at its own moment and the timeline scrolls when it reaches an edge; dragging pans freely past either end of the recording; the waveform takes the full height, zooms anywhere in it and is drawn as rounded bars. Tapping a recording in the library opens the editor, which starts playing: the list has no player of its own any more.
